# Release checklist

## Scope and docs
- [ ] Release scope matches implemented behavior.
- [ ] README and relevant docs updated.
- [ ] API/config changes documented.
- [ ] Changelog and roadmap accurate.

## Quality
- [ ] Frontend lint passes.
- [ ] Frontend build passes.
- [ ] Backend tests pass.
- [ ] Mail tests use mock transport or owned inbox.
- [ ] Partial failure and retry behavior tested.
- [ ] Accessibility checks performed for UI changes.

## Security
- [ ] Authentication and authorization verified.
- [ ] Input, message, and recipient limits enforced.
- [ ] Rate limits and abuse monitoring enabled.
- [ ] Consent, suppression, and unsubscribe tested.
- [ ] Secrets rotated and stored outside source.
- [ ] Logs reviewed for sensitive data.
- [ ] Provider policy reviewed.

## Operations
- [ ] Deployment config reviewed.
- [ ] Health checks and alerts verified.
- [ ] Rollback documented.
- [ ] Incident response ready.
- [ ] Retention and deletion verified.
